prompt: Label the data flows with their protocols: HTTPS from the browser to the API, gRPC from the API to the worker, and SQL from both services to the database.

args.source:
flowchart LR
  browser[Browser] --> api[API]
  api --> worker[Worker]
  api --> db[(Database)]
  worker --> db

checks.why: each flow labelled with its protocol

expect.$expr: (() => { const l = (s, t) => (v.edges.find((e) => e.source === s && e.target === t) || {}).label || ''; return /https/i.test(l('browser', 'api')) && /grpc/i.test(l('api', 'worker')) && /sql/i.test(l('api', 'db')) && /sql/i.test(l('worker', 'db')); })()
